zh.title: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙A320航線全在佛州 奧蘭多—聖胡安居冠
zh.summary: 根據Cirium數據，捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的A320航線是奧蘭多—聖胡安，全年雙向共3562班次；最繁忙的11條A320航線全數觸及佛州，反映該公司在精神航空退出後加速擴張佛州網絡。
body: 捷藍航空2026年最繁忙的空中巴士A320航線不是橫貫大陸的商務幹線，而是奧蘭多—聖胡安。根據Cirium數據，這條航線雙向全年共飛航3562班次、提供約57.3萬個座位，平均航程1189英里。更值得注意的是，最繁忙的11條A320城市對全數觸及佛州：勞德岱堡—拉瓜迪亞以3350班次居次，勞德岱堡—聖胡安以3280班次排名第三。

佛州擴張的直接推力是精神航空倒閉留下的缺口。捷藍7月宣布，夏季自勞德岱堡出發的班次接近每日130班，較2025年增加逾75%，目標是年底前達到每日約150班；按冬季班表計算，勞德岱堡已是捷藍起降班次最多的機場，約2.15萬班，高於一年前的約1.37萬班。機隊方面，截至2026年9月30日，A320佔捷藍298架飛機中的129架，而A220預計2027年交付7架、2028年9架、2029年10架、2030年2架。財務壓力仍在：捷藍第三季虧損2.57億美元，現金自2025年底的19.5億美元降至9月的12.6億美元，目標是2027年恢復持續獲利。

en.title: JetBlue's busiest A320 flights in 2026 all touch Florida
en.summary: Cirium data shows JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is Orlando–San Juan, with 3,562 flights in both directions, and all 11 of its busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida, reflecting the airline's rapid Florida expansion after Spirit Airlines' collapse.
body: JetBlue's busiest Airbus A320 route in 2026 is not a transcontinental link between two major business centres. According to Cirium, it is Orlando–San Juan, a leisure-heavy connection that recorded 3,562 flights in both directions, offering 572,976 seats across an average sector length of 1,189 miles. More revealing still, all 11 of the airline's busiest A320 city pairs touch Florida: Fort Lauderdale–LaGuardia follows with 3,350 combined flights and 542,688 seats, and Fort Lauderdale–San Juan with 3,280 flights and 531,288 seats.

The immediate catalyst is Spirit Airlines' collapse. JetBlue moved to fill part of the gap and said it intended to reach around 150 daily departures from Fort Lauderdale by year-end; its July announcement put summer departures near 130, more than 75% above 2025 levels. According to Simple Flying, citing Cirium schedule data, Fort Lauderdale is now JetBlue's busiest airport by scheduled departures, with roughly 21,500 winter departures against nearly 13,700 a year earlier. On fleet, the A320 accounts for 129 of JetBlue's 298 aircraft as of September 30, 2026, while its fleet plan lists seven A220 deliveries in 2027, nine in 2028, 10 in 2029, and two in 2030. The finances remain strained: the airline reported a third-quarter loss of $257 million, with cash falling from $1.95 billion at the end of 2025 to $1.26 billion in September, and it is targeting sustained profitability in 2027.

zh.title: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）衝出跑道 觸發FAA地面停飛措施
zh.summary: 聯邦快遞MD-11貨機於邁阿密國際機場（MIA）26R跑道衝出跑道，觸發FAA地面停飛。
body: 據AeroTime報導，一架聯邦快遞（FedEx Express）麥道MD-11貨機於2026年11月25日晚間，在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）降落時衝出跑道。這起事件發生在美國感恩節假期前夕，導致該機場四條跑道中的三條被迫關閉，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）實施地面停飛措施。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）確認，涉事航機為聯邦快遞910號班機（FedEx Flight 910），該航班稍早從位於曼菲斯的Frederick W. Smith International Airport（MEM）起飛前往邁阿密。邁阿密機場官員進一步說明，該架貨機係在26R跑道降落時衝出跑道範圍。
在人員安全方面，Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office表示，這架聯邦快遞MD-11貨機上共有兩名人員，事發後並未傳出任何人員受傷的報告。
由於四條跑道中有三條因這起衝出跑道事件而關閉，邁阿密國際機場（MIA）的航班運作受到顯著影響，並觸發美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的地面停飛措施。AeroTime報導指出，機場的航班中斷與延誤情況持續至2026年11月26日凌晨，FAA通報現場出現長達數小時的航班延誤。
在機隊背景方面，聯邦快遞於2026年5月才剛恢復MD-11機型的飛航運作。此前，美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）曾於2025年11月對該型機實施停飛令，直到2026年5月解除停飛令後，聯邦快遞才重新派遣MD-11貨機執飛任務。

en.title: FedEx MD-11 overruns runway at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggers FAA ground stop
en.summary: A FedEx Express MD-11 freighter overran Runway 26R at Miami International Airport (MIA), triggering an FAA ground stop.
body: A FedEx Express McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter overran a runway while landing at Miami International Airport (MIA) on the evening of November 25, 2026, according to a report published by AeroTime. The landing overrun occurred on the eve of the US Thanksgiving holiday, forcing the closure of three of the airport’s four runways and triggering a Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) ground stop.

In its identification of the aircraft, the FAA confirmed that the freighter was operating as FedEx Flight 910, which had departed from Frederick W. Smith International Airport (MEM) in Memphis. Miami airport officials stated that the aircraft overran Runway 26R while landing at the airport.

The Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office reported that two people were on board the McDonnell Douglas MD-11 freighter when the overrun occurred at Miami International Airport. According to the sheriff’s office, no injuries were reported as a result of the incident.

Because three of the four runways at Miami International Airport were forced to close following the overrun, the FAA ground stop had an immediate impact on traffic ahead of the US Thanksgiving holiday. AeroTime reported that operational disruptions continued into the early hours of November 26, 2026, with the FAA reporting delays of several hours.

The overrun also comes months after the cargo carrier returned the aircraft type to service. According to AeroTime, FedEx resumed MD-11 flights in May 2026 after the FAA lifted a grounding of the MD-11 aircraft type that had originally been imposed in November 2025.

zh.title: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6,000萬歐元 推動ATR72水陸兩棲消防機計畫
zh.summary: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6千萬歐元建ATR72消防機設施。
body: Positive Aviation宣佈投資6,000萬歐元，規劃興建兩座製造設施，推動ATR72水陸兩棲消防機改裝計畫。公司計畫在土魯斯（Toulouse）投入3,600萬歐元，設立主要工廠，改裝ATR72渦輪螺旋槳飛機。
另有2,400萬歐元將投入法國西北部Vannes的新工廠，生產安裝於改裝後ATR72的浮筒。浮筒將在Groupe Carboman子公司Multiplast協力下生產。
這項投資宣佈前不久，Positive Aviation獲選為「Première Usine」計畫第11批項目之一；該計畫與France 2030倡議相關。AeroTime引述多家媒體報導，該公司截至2026年11月約籌得3,000萬歐元，其中約一半來自私人投資人。

en.title: Positive Aviation announces €60 million for amphibious ATR72 firefighting project
en.summary: Positive Aviation plans a €60 million investment in two facilities for amphibious ATR72 firefighting conversions.
body: Positive Aviation, a French startup, has announced a €60 million investment to build two manufacturing facilities for its amphibious ATR72 firefighting conversion project. It plans to invest €36 million in its planned main facility in Toulouse, dedicated to retrofitting the turboprops.

A further €24 million is earmarked for a new factory in Vannes, northwestern France, to produce floats for the converted ATR72s. The floats will be made in collaboration with Multiplast, a subsidiary of Groupe Carboman.

The announcement came shortly after Positive Aviation was selected for the 11th batch of the Première Usine programme, associated with the France 2030 initiative. Citing multiple media sources, AeroTime reported that the startup had raised approximately €30 million by November 2026, with around half from private investors.
